env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
logos build -o $WORK/reach-js-logos.wasm ./reach
logos build -o $WORK/noreach-js-logos.wasm ./noreach
go build -o $WORK/reach-js-go.wasm ./reach
go build -o $WORK/noreach-js-go.wasm ./noreach
env GOOS=wasip1
logos build -o $WORK/reach-wasi-logos.wasm ./reach
logos build -o $WORK/noreach-wasi-logos.wasm ./noreach
go build -o $WORK/reach-wasi-go.wasm ./reach
go build -o $WORK/noreach-wasi-go.wasm ./noreach
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
go run ./sizecheck $WORK/reach-js-logos.wasm $WORK/noreach-js-logos.wasm 8000
stdout '^ok diff='
go run ./sizecheck $WORK/reach-js-go.wasm $WORK/noreach-js-go.wasm 8000
stdout '^ok diff='
go run ./sizecheck $WORK/reach-wasi-logos.wasm $WORK/noreach-wasi-logos.wasm 8000
stdout '^ok diff='
go run ./sizecheck $WORK/reach-wasi-go.wasm $WORK/noreach-wasi-go.wasm 8000
stdout '^ok diff='

-- noreach/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 0 {
		println(len(os.Args))
	}
}
-- sizecheck/main.go --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: sizecheck reach noreach bound")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	rdata, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read reach:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	ndata, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read noreach:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	bound, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[3])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "bad bound:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	marker := []byte("LOGS_DEADCODE_PROBE_7f3a9c2e5b1d48f0a6c9e7735d2c1a4f9b3e51c7d2e8")
	if !bytes.Contains(rdata, marker) {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "reach missing marker")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if bytes.Contains(ndata, marker) {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "noreach keeps marker")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	diff := len(rdata) - len(ndata)
	if diff < bound {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "diff %d below bound %d\n", diff, bound)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("ok diff=%d bound=%d\n", diff, bound)
}
